newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randgold to list on Nasdaq in February.
newsitem.headline: Randgold to list on Nasdaq in February.

text.p: Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd will list on Nasdaq in February, chairman Peter Flack said on Monday.
"The listing of the five mining companies took place in October and Randgold will be next month," Flack told Reuters after the company's December quarter results presentation.

Randgold in October listed the American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) of Blyvooruitzicht Gold Mining Co Ltd, Durban Roodepoort Deep Ltd, Grootvlei Proprietary Mines Ltd and Harmony Gold Mining Co Ltd on Nasdaq.
The five mining companies were the first South African companies to be listed on Nasdaq in 15 years.
The company said on October the listings would further improve the international market visibility of the companies as well as the liquidity of their ADRs.
